activity.notes: After the conquest of Mexico-Tenochtitlan, Charles V appointed Hernán Cortés Governor and Captain General of New Spain in 1522. Crown officials increasingly restricted his authority and in 1528 he was removed from government and returned to Spain. ATLAS therefore models the formal colonial governorship of New Spain and does not attach Cortés to the Aztec Empire as a ruler of that pre-conquest polity.

sources.title: Hernán Cortés authority record — Spanish Ministry of Culture
sources.citation_text: The Spanish Ministry of Culture record states that Cortés was appointed Governor and Captain General of New Spain in 1522 and removed from government in 1528.
